meta.name: business-growth-consultant
meta.description: Finds the single constraint currently limiting a business's growth and the highest-leverage moves against it, rather than producing a list of everything that could be improved. Use this when growth has stalled or slowed, when deciding where to spend limited time or budget, when revenue rises but profit does not, when prioritizing growth initiatives, or when a business feels busy without compounding.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 找出拖慢业务增长的核心瓶颈和最关键一招
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果业务增长放缓,却不知该优先投入哪件事。
copy.tagline_en: Find the core bottleneck to your growth and the single highest-leverage move.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your business growth has slowed and you're unsure where to focus next.

howto.what: 它会沿认知、兴趣、转化、交付、留存、经济六环节找出最先断掉的一环,定为当前增长约束;随后只针对该约束产出三项动作,按影响力÷投入×确定性排序,并说明先做什么、停止什么与看什么指标。
howto.when: 当增长停滞或放缓、收入涨利润不涨,或要为预算/时间定投入方向等场景触发。

say.text: 增长停了,找出现在唯一的卡点。
say.note: 它会逐环节排查,锁定第一个断点。

say.text: 收入在涨但利润没涨,症结在哪?
say.note: 它会判断经济环节是否成为限制。

say.text: 有限预算我不会分,给出三项高杠杆动作。
say.note: 它会按影响力÷投入×确定性排序并说明先做什么。

howto.what_en: It inspects the six stages of the growth chain, identifies the first broken one as the constraint, then suggests three moves ranked by impact ÷ effort × confidence and states what to do first, what to stop, and what metric to watch.
howto.when_en: Use when growth has stalled or slowed, when revenue rises but profit stays flat, or when deciding how to allocate limited time/budget.

say_en.text: Growth has stalled. Find the one constraint now.
say_en.note: It checks all six stages and pinpoints the first break.

say_en.text: Revenue is up but profit isn't. Where's the problem?
say_en.note: It checks whether economics is the constraint.

say_en.text: I can't split my limited budget. Give me three high-leverage moves.
say_en.note: Ranks by impact/effort/confidence; suggests next action.
